name: Italian Ground Turkey White Bean Skillet

fit.note: 422 cal / 21g carbs per serving clears the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb band; ground turkey + canned cannellini + canned tomatoes is a cheap weigh-and-divide skillet with no seafood.

evidence: Not a duplicate of any turkey white-bean catalog entry: mediterranean-turkey-white-bean-stew-bowls is a broth stew served over rice with olives+kale, turkey-chili-verde-white-beans is a salsa/sour-cream chili over rice, turkey-sausage-kale-white-bean-soup and turkey-minestrone are soups (the latter with pasta), and turkey-white-bean-cassoulet is a bacon/sausage French braise over rice; this candidate is a dry one-pan Italian skillet (Italian seasoning + parmesan + spinach + fire-roasted tomato, NO broth, NO starch), so it shares only the bean+tomato base while differing on starch and method.
cross_protein_collisions: Structurally this is an 'Italian ground-meat + white bean + tomato + spinach + parmesan dry skillet'. A ground-beef, ground-chicken, or Italian-sausage/pork version of the same Tuscan white-bean skillet would be the same dish under a different protein - decider should watch the pork/sausage and chicken lanes for a 'Tuscan/Italian white bean [sausage|chicken] skillet' twin. (Accepted italian-sausage-peppers-onions-skillet is sausage+peppers with no beans - NOT this dish.)
unmapped_note: Carrying unmapped ingredients is wanted per run v2.1 5.1 (pricer-lane exercise); not penalized.
